title: Maradona 'Hand of God' Goal 1986 World Cup
summary: A one-minute clip of Diego Maradona's 'Hand of God' goal against England at the 1986 World Cup. It is part of a ClassicEngland series of unforgettable moments.
why: HN uses it as footage of a famous officiating failure, linked in Maradona obituary and video-review threads.
